title: R1 audit remediation: fail-closed admission/lease correlation, cockpit observation-integrity gating, wake generation semantics, branch toggle, epoch lease expiry, real freshness
description: R1 remediation on audited HEAD e633e09 (correction BASE), still vs integration BASE 07f22db. F1: matchingAdmission requires exact fence+generation when both present, never fence-only fallback; SETTLED/RELEASED/EXPIRED/expired-epoch leases never yield ACTIVE admission/pass; admission alone proves ADMITTED/PASS STATUS UNKNOWN not PASS RUNNING. F2: cockpit observation_error downgrades all cockpit-derived claims (allocation, planner, mission, execution, evidence, review) while scheduler/driver observations stay authoritative. F3: wake pending derives from pending_generation vs claimed_generation, not stale pending_reasons. F4: scheduler wording distinguishes queue state from held lease; claimed never presented as admitted. F5: all five conditional nodes carry branch=true so collapse hides only inactive branches and their edges, restoring cleanly. F6: lease expires_at typed number|null epoch-ms with safe conversion (invalid != expired). F7: policy freshness records actual response atMs; render ticks never refresh; stale/out-of-order responses rejected via shouldApplyResponse. 47-scenario vitest (25 new R1 regressions) + 6th Playwright spec exercising the real branches toggle interaction. Test file remains at src/__tests__/ under the root-vitest-only tooling exception; production scope unchanged: apps/mission-control-ui/** only, zero backend/authority changes.
